title: Clear words and a fair measure

captions.physics: Stating the terms of mutual promises
captions.emotions: Feeling a decision treats both fairly

meaning: You can give mutual promises a clear form and feel a decision is fair when order in conversation accounts for both people’s possibilities.
text: Understandable terms can give your shared word particular weight. The Emperor in the physical position of Vishuddha helps formulate agreement in sequence: naming a request, clarifying a promise’s boundaries and stating a clear outcome. The Emperor in energy plays a different role, sustaining an intention to be dependable and responsible for what you say. Justice in emotions responds with a feeling of fair proportion. The decision accounts for each person’s involvement and possibilities. The repeated card distinguishes your way of speaking from the motive behind giving words that certainty.

For example, you agree how to warn each other about a change of shared plan. A vague “Let me know beforehand” becomes a condition both can realistically meet. **A dependable word becomes shared through fair terms.** You can explain which timing works and why an exception may sometimes be needed. Agreement brings relief because one person has avoided an impossible promise merely to settle the other.

The vulnerable point is wanting perfect equality in every future case. A simple agreement gathers qualifications until conversation resembles protection against any uncertainty. The motive of dependability stays constructive, but the form can grow heavy. A sufficiently clear condition offers support now and leaves new circumstances room for discussion when they actually arise.
